displayName: OCI-WSTG08-002: JavaScript Execution via eval or document.write
description:
Detects unsafe JavaScript patterns including eval(), document.write(), and innerHTML with untrusted input

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: javascript execution via eval or document.write

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg08_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%javascript%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%execution%') AND "value" > 0
